annotation.title_clean: Using Virtual Reality for scenario-based Responsible Research and Innovation approach for Human Robot Co-production
annotation.title_en: Using Virtual Reality for scenario-based Responsible Research and Innovation approach for Human Robot Co-production
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Aschenbrenner, D.; Van Tol, D.; Rusak, Z.; Werker, C.
annotation.venue: 3rd IEEE International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Virtual Reality (AIVR 2020)
annotation.summary_en: TU Delft conference paper (IEEE AIVR 2020) proposing VR scenarios within a Responsible Research and Innovation approach. The scenarios would draw out stakeholder reactions to collaborative robots in Industry 4.0 workplaces, so that human-robot co-production can be designed to feel like teamwork rather than a threat to workers' jobs.
key_provisions_or_claims: VR scenarios can be used to explore how stakeholders react to robots introduced into close collaboration with workers
Responsible Research and Innovation requires investigating the thoughts and feelings of all stakeholders
Workers in workplaces going through Industry 4.0 change fear that robots will make their jobs redundant
Successful human-robot interaction can increase productivity and improve worker well-being
